rules.title: Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing Ordinance
rules.requirement: The sale, licensing, and use of algorithmic devices that use or incorporate nonpublic competitor data to advise or recommend rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental properties are prohibited in the City of San Diego.
rules.summary_plain: San Diego bans software that uses secret competitor data to set or suggest rents or occupancy levels for rental homes.
rules.summary_plain_es: San Diego prohíbe el software que utiliza datos secretos de competidores para establecer o sugerir rentas o niveles de ocupación para viviendas en alquiler.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to all residential rental properties in the City of San Diego using algorithmic devices as defined.
rules.exemptions_text: Does not apply to software that publishes reports using publicly available aggregated data or software used to set rents or income limits under affordable housing program guidelines.
rules.citation: San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 9, Article 8, Division 11, Sections 98.1101-98.1104
rules.quoted_span: The proposed ordinance bans the sale, licensing, and use of an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental properties. Algorithmic devices are a software or product that uses or incorporates one or more algorithms to perform calculations of nonpublic competitor data concerning rental rates, occupancy levels, or other information regarding the leasing of residential rental property to advise, or recommend to a landlord, rental rates or occupancy levels.
